name: Slime Slayers
desc:
Jump into the ultimate slime-smashing adventure! 💥 Take down crazy colorful slimes, stack up gold, level up like crazy, and unlock epic new worlds packed with tough bosses and insane loot! 🗡️

⚔️ Slice through waves of slimes and wreck massive bosses
🗺️ Explore awesome worlds full of challenges and secrets
💰 Snag epic loot and upgrade your gear to OP status
👥 Squad up with friends or go solo and show your skills
🏆 Prove you’re the best in special events for big rewards

Max Level: 1100 (for now 😉)

Controls:
[Q/L2] – Dash

Tags: Simulator, Slime, RPG, Magic, Boss Fights
